parameters.command:
=
:put "##VERSION"
/system resource print
:put "##IFACE"
/interface print terse
:put "##BRIDGEPORT"
/interface bridge port print terse
:put "##DHCP"
/ip dhcp-client print terse
:put "##NAT"
/ip firewall nat print terse
:put "##MANGLE"
/ip firewall mangle print terse
:put "##ROUTE"
/ip route print terse
:put "##RTABLE"
/routing table print terse
:put "##FILTER"
/ip firewall filter print terse
:put "##ALIST"
/ip firewall address-list print terse where list="slh-pcc-exclude"
:put "##DNS"
/ip dns print
:put "##END"

=
:put "##DHCP"
/ip dhcp-client print terse
:put "##ROUTE"
/ip route print terse where comment~"^(Marquee|Backup) WAN[12]$"
:put "##MANGLE"
/ip firewall mangle print terse
:put "##NAT"
/ip firewall nat print terse where action=masquerade
:put "##CONN"
:put ("WAN1=" . [:len [/ip firewall connection find connection-mark="WAN1"]])
:put ("WAN2=" . [:len [/ip firewall connection find connection-mark="WAN2"]])
:put "##END"
